scientific_integrity: The all-dimensional limits are derived analytically from incidence Gram determinants, Gaussian maxima and local-dependence Poisson approximation; finite checking is corroborative, not certification.
scientific_limitations: The graph-degree condition is sufficient, not claimed necessary.
The atomic law occurs only as a weak limit for finely scaled broom families.
The possibility of an equivalent formulation in less-indexed Gaussian-extreme-value literature is retained.
Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Gaussian, half-normal, and atomic width limits for equal-volume tree symmetric-edge polytopes
